description: Text to speech (TTS): turn up to 2,000 characters of text into spoken WAV audio (44.1 kHz, 16-bit mono) in one of 10 standard voices (M1-M5 male, F1-F5 female) across 31 languages. Base voices only: no speed, steps or personas. Best for agent narration, status updates, alerts and short spoken responses. Costs $0.005 for 1-500 chars and $0.005 for 501-2000 chars. Charged only for a 200 that carries audio: the service refuses with 400 before payment (charged:false) text with no letter or digit, text whose script does not match lang, non-Latin text without lang, speed outside 0.7-2.0, steps outside 1-100, or an unknown voice, lang or response_format; audio that fails its post-synthesis check answers 502 with charged:false.

lang.description: Language code, default en for Latin-script text; must match the script of the text and is required for non-Latin text
